name: Eopinacosaurus
sum: Eopinacosaurus is an ankylosaurine from the Campanian of Mongolia and China, erected in 2026 for Pinacosaurus mephistocephalus.
holotype: IMM 96BM3/1, a large articulated skeleton found in 1996 by a Belgian-Chinese expedition — Bayan Mandahu Formation, China.
material: A second record from the Djadokhta Formation of Mongolia is listed by PBDB.
biology: Known from skeletons; the sources used give no behavioural data.
author: Penkalski 2026
